changelog: v2.7.9: adopted publicly-documented tunables - tcp_frto=2 (spurious-RTO detection for elevator/handover stalls), tcp_notsent_lowat=16384 (lower interactive latency), crowd/weak scenarios now prefer CAKE qdisc (anti-bufferbloat, falls back to fq_codel); WebUI shows F-RTO/notsent_lowat/MPTCP support
